title: Free Transformer selective-operator and path-mediation external validity
question: Does the calibrated global/conditioned/abstain camera identify at least two target-selective events and close held-out path mediation in freely trained same-executor Transformers across depth?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Per-layer held-out target/null operator fit and frozen upstream-mediator intervention battery.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: At least four of six models, including one per depth, yield two passing events and close target, context, wrong, null, block and rescue gates.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: The frozen breadth conjunction or any required confirmation family fails.

hypothesis_predictions.observable: The same layerwise and interventional response battery.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: Free state geometry causes abstention, target/null collision or failed mediation breadth.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: The complete frozen cross-depth conjunction passes.

data_contract.cluster_unit: One frozen object-value world evaluated in one independently trained network.
data_contract.split_rule: Worlds are disjoint; discovery fits, selection chooses per-layer camera and event pair, confirmation never reselects.
data_contract.answer_payload_rule: Behavior failures and camera abstentions remain in the six-model breadth denominator.

metrics.estimator: Natural task accuracy and executor gap.
Target relative error, null leakage and idempotence for global/conditioned/abstention selection.
Correct response cosine, relative error and behavior transfer.
Wrong identity, matched-null, context retention and manifold proximity.
Downstream block and correct/wrong mediator rescue.

typed_gates.rule: Each model reaches at least 0.995 task accuracy and executor gap at most 0.0002.
At least two passing events per model and at least four models with one actionable model per depth.
Every breadth-authorized model passes correct response geometry and behavior transfer.
Wrong, null, context and manifold gates all pass in every breadth-authorized model.
Frozen upstream block and correct/wrong mediator rescue gates pass in every breadth-authorized model.

budget.right_censoring_rule: Nonqualified and abstaining models remain in the breadth denominator; any failed dependency stops confirmation and pretrained escalation.

stopping_rules: Behavior failure stops camera interpretation for that model but remains in breadth.
At least two selected events are required before intervention.
Confirmation never reselects camera type or event layer.
No seed, depth or threshold repair is permitted.

adjudication.failure_claim: All six models passed behavior, but zero models yielded two selected events; confirmation intervention and path mediation were not authorized.

forbids_on_failure: claim that path mediation is absent
